title: Add WriteCSVToHTML function to Go CSV reader library
description: Brownfield Go task: add a WriteCSVToHTML function that converts a CSV file into an HTML table string.

task_spec.prompt:
Add WriteCSVToHTML to internal/csvutil/csvutil.go. All existing tests must still pass. func WriteCSVToHTML(path string) (string, error) — reads the CSV at path using ParseCSV — returns an empty string for empty files (no error) — wraps the first row as a with cells — wraps all subsequent rows as with cells — structure: ... ...
col1col2
val1val2
— do NOT add newlines or extra whitespace between tags — use string concatenation or strings.Builder (no html/template required) All existing tests must still pass. Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: WriteCSVToHTML returns empty string for empty CSV
First CSV row becomes <thead> with <th> cells
Returns error if file cannot be read
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
